title: Binding SnO2 Nanocrystals in Nitrogen-Doped Graphene Sheets as Anode Materials for Lithium-Ion Batteries

notes: Spine: hydrazine-vapour reduction binds 4-5 nm SnO2 NCs in N-RGO -> interfacial Sn-N-C/Sn-O-C bonds keep NCs dispersed (branch 1) and micropores form (branch 2) -> joint high reversible capacity -> rate and 500-cycle performance (two PRF branches) -> conclusion; MEC b10 bridges. Packet defects: F2 and F4 linked text are the same garbled page-join (Sn L3 sentence runs into the cycling paragraph); synthesis, XPS, AES, BET and CV/GCD discussion are missing; F4 caption spans are shifted by one panel (F4a span "EDX spectrum" on the STEM image); F3c/F3b current density absent. Audits: XANES difference marginal vs "obvious increase"; capacity rising above SnO2 alloying capacity; control samples named without data; post-cycling Sn map partly streaky (q18 partial). Lost: Sn L3 XANES, EIS/Rf (SI), SEI SEM and cycled HRTEM (SI S7-S10).
